title: processkit shared-server access rejection
description: Body of an HTTP response with which the shared server rejects a request for authentication, a per-principal or per-server limit, or an unknown path (access-control@v1 PK-ACC-051, PK-ACC-055). Same shape as security@v1 schemas/http-rejection.schema.json, with access-control codes. Content-Type is application/json. The body never says why authentication failed and never contains request content, header values, or credentials.

message.description: One redacted sentence. Not a contract; tests use data.code.

code.description: HTTP status per code: access.unauthenticated 401; access.principal-limit and access.server-limit 429; access.unknown-path 404.
